name: A1 / MAMI dark-photon search
full_name: A1 Collaboration dark-photon search at the Mainz Microtron
summary: A1 / MAMI dark-photon search is based at the Mainz Microtron (MAMI), Johannes Gutenberg-Universität Mainz. This named dark-photon analysis uses the multipurpose A1 nuclear-physics apparatus; the record is limited to that dark-sector program.
detection_principle: An electron beam striking a target produces e⁺e⁻ pairs; high-resolution magnetic spectrometers measure dilepton invariant masses to seek narrow resonances above a smooth QED background.

results.summary: No light U(1) boson; mass-dependent exclusion curves were obtained.

science_scope: Tests dark-sector models by producing candidate particles or portal mediators at accelerators. Invisible accelerator final states or mediator particles alone do not establish cosmic-dark-matter identity; lifetimes, abundance and other experiments must also be considered.
